_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the CorpBot egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: CorpBot
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: CorpBot is a Python Discord bot with moderation, music, games and plenty of fun commands. Installs its latest code and its Python packages on first start.
startup: if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo "Set the bot token in the server's startup settings, then start it again."; exit 1; fi; h=$(cat .git/HEAD 2>/dev/null)$(python3 --version); if [ ! -x venv/bin/python ] || [ "$h" != "$(cat venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing CorpBot's Python packages. This takes a few minutes."; python3 Install.py --no-interaction --clear-venv && echo "$h" > venv/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; exec venv/bin/python -u Main.py

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CorpBot: clones CorpBot from its Git repository, or pulls the newest
# code into an existing copy. CorpBot has no releases, so this is always
# its latest code. settings_dict.json and the bot's saved settings are
# kept; its Python packages are installed when the server starts.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=https://github.com/corpnewt/CorpBot.py

git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server
[ -d .git ] || git init -q
git fetch -q --depth 1 "$repo" HEAD
# Only CorpBot's own files are replaced; settings and the venv aren't part of it.
git -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q -f FETCH_HEAD
commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

if [ ! -f settings_dict.json ]; then
    echo '{"token": "", "prefix": "$"}' | jq . > settings_dict.json
    echo "Wrote settings_dict.json."
fi
echo "Installed CorpBot at commit $commit. Its Python packages are installed when it first starts."

variables.name: Bot token
variables.description: Your Discord bot's token, from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Prefix
variables.description: The prefix for the bot's commands, such as $ or !.
